description: Vrije Universiteit Brussel publishes an African hydropower atlas combining plant characteristics with seasonal generation profiles for electricity-system modelling. The HydroShare repository’s version 2.0 provides spreadsheet and GIS materials under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse, with a public spatial extent spanning the continent. The describing article explains that continental hydrological modelling supplies profiles for existing and prospective plants. The resource supports seasonal hydro-supply assumptions in power-system simulations alongside wind and solar scenarios. Modelled profiles are not continuous operating measurements, and plant operation, storage and future development assumptions introduce uncertainty in reuse. HydroShare identifies newer versions, so this archived release should be cited explicitly. No directly related catalogue resource was found.
